    e.customer_id,
    e.event_ts,
    e.event_type,

      'page STRING, referrer STRING, query STRING, results INT, product_id INT, qty INT,

    )                                               AS p,
    get_json_object(e.payload, '$.device.os')       AS device_os_raw
  FROM web_events e
  WHERE e.customer_id IS NOT NULL
),
gaps AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    LAG(event_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY event_ts, event_id) AS prev_ts,
    CASE
      WHEN LAG(event_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY event_ts, event_id) IS NULL THEN 1
      WHEN unix_timestamp(event_ts)
           - unix_timestamp(LAG(event_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY event_ts, event_id)) > 30 * 60 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS is_new_session
  FROM parsed
),
sessionized AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_session) OVER (
      PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY event_ts, event_id
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS session_seq
  FROM gaps
)
SELECT
  customer_id,
  concat_ws('-', 'S', lpad(CAST(customer_id AS STRING), 4, '0'), CAST(session_seq AS STRING)) AS session_key,
  MIN(event_ts)                                                       AS session_start,
  MAX(event_ts)                                                       AS session_end,
  round((unix_timestamp(MAX(event_ts)) - unix_timestamp(MIN(event_ts))) / 60.0, 1) AS duration_min,
  COUNT(*)                                                            AS events,
  COUNT(DISTINCT event_type)                                          AS distinct_event_types,
  collect_list(event_type)                                            AS event_path,
  first(p.referrer, true)                                             AS entry_referrer,
  coalesce(max(p.device.type), 'unknown')                             AS device_type,
  max(CASE WHEN event_type = 'checkout' THEN p.cart_value END)        AS checkout_value,
  max(CASE WHEN p IS NULL OR p.page IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1     AS has_bad_payload,
  array_join(array_distinct(collect_list(p.query)), ' | ')            AS search_terms
FROM sessionized
GROUP BY customer_id, session_seq
ORDER BY customer_id, session_start

    .join(fx.alias("fx"), F.col("fx.order_id") == F.col("f.order_id"), "inner")
    .join(pay.alias("p"), F.col("p.order_id") == F.col("f.order_id"), "left")
    .select(
        "f.*", "fx.rate_to_usd",
        F.when(F.col("f.status") == "CANCELLED", 0).otherwise(F.col("f.net_usd")).alias("rev_usd"),
        F.when(F.col("f.status") == "CANCELLED", 0).otherwise(F.col("f.cogs_usd")).alias("cost_usd"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("p.refunded_local"), F.lit(0)) * F.col("fx.rate_to_usd")).cast("decimal(18,4)").alias("refund_usd"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("p.captured_local"), F.lit(0)) * F.col("fx.rate_to_usd")).cast("decimal(18,4)").alias("captured_usd"),
    )
)

order_margin = (
    order_pl.alias("pl")
    .join(df_order_tickets.alias("t"), F.col("t.order_id") == F.col("pl.order_id"), "left")
    .select(
        "pl.*",
        F.col("t.worst_priority"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("t.has_open_ticket"), F.lit(False)).alias("has_open_ticket"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("t.ticket_cost_risk"), F.lit(False)).alias("ticket_cost_risk"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("t.sla_breaches"), F.lit(0)).alias("sla_breaches"),
        F.col("t.avg_csat"),
    )
    .select(
        "*",
        F.col("pl.rev_usd") - F.col("pl.cost_usd") - F.when(F.col("pl.status") == "RETURNED", F.col("pl.refund_usd")).otherwise(0).alias("gross_margin_usd"),
        F.round(F.try_divide(F.col("pl.rev_usd") - F.col("pl.cost_usd") - F.when(F.col("pl.status") == "RETURNED", F.col("pl.refund_usd")).otherwise(0), F.col("pl.rev_usd")) * 100, 2).alias("margin_pct"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("t.tickets"), F.lit(0)).alias("tickets"),
        "worst_priority",
        "has_open_ticket",
        "ticket_cost_risk",
        "sla_breaches",
        "avg_csat",
    )
)

flagged = (
    order_margin.alias("m")
    .select(
        "m.*",
        F.filter(F.array(
            F.when(F.col("m.margin_pct") < 30, "LOW_MARGIN"),
            F.when(F.col("m.has_estimated_cost"), "EST_COST"),
            F.when(F.col("m.has_stockout_product"), "STOCK_RISK"),
            F.when(F.col("m.ticket_cost_risk"), "TICKET_RISK"),
            F.when(F.col("m.sla_breaches") > 0, "SLA_BREACH"),
            F.when(F.col("m.discount_usd") > 0.1 * F.col("m.net_usd"), "DEEP_DISC"),
            F.when(F.col("m.status").isin("DELIVERED", "SHIPPED") & (F.abs(F.col("m.captured_usd") - F.col("m.net_usd")) > 1), "PAY_MISMATCH"),
            F.when(F.col("m.tier_at_order") == "UNKNOWN", "NO_TIER"),
        ), lambda x: x.isNotNull()).alias("flags"),
    )
)

scored = (
    flagged.alias("f")
    .select(
        "f.*",
        F.size(F.col("flags")).alias("n_flags"),
        F.round(
            0.5 * F.coalesce(F.percent_rank().over(Window.orderBy("f.gross_margin_usd")), F.lit(0))
            + 0.3 * F.coalesce(F.percent_rank().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("f.margin_pct").asc_nulls_first())), F.lit(0))
            - 0.1 * F.least(F.size(F.col("flags")), F.lit(4)) / 4.0
            - 0.1 * F.when(F.col("f.has_open_ticket"), 1).otherwise(0),
        ).alias("health_score"),
        F.sum(F.col("gross_margin_usd")).over(Window.partitionBy(F.col("country_code")).orderBy("f.order_ts", "f.order_id")).alias("country_cum_margin"),
        F.avg(F.col("margin_pct")).over(Window.partitionBy(F.col("tier_at_order"))).alias("tier_avg_margin_pct"),
        (F.col("gross_margin_usd") - F.lag(F.col("gross_margin_usd")).over(Window.partitionBy(F.col("customer_id")).orderBy("f.order_ts"))).alias("margin_vs_prev_order"),
    )
)
